description: Servicio de Bomberos de la Ciudad Autónoma de Melilla is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ciudad Autónoma de Melilla. The portal shows the English title as "Fire Service of the Autonomous City of Melilla" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ciudad Autónoma de Melilla. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
